topic: Speed to quote beats speed to lead. Built entirely from the ScaileAI sales deck.

slides.ctaPromise: comment it and I will send you the speed to quote breakdown

caption:
Your competitor did not outsell you. They just quoted first.

1. The first quote wins. 73% of leads go to whoever responds first, and that window is about five minutes. You are on a job site for most of it.
2. Speed to lead is not enough. A fast reply with no price is still a delay. Let me get back to you is a lost job.
3. Put the price in the chat. No pdf, no callback, no site visit first. Lead to booked in about ninety seconds.
4. Book while intent is high. The calendar opens in the same conversation, and confirmations send themselves.
5. Work the leads you already paid for. Old and cold leads get followed up automatically across sms, email and chat.

It is not speed to lead. It is speed to quote.

Want the breakdown on your own numbers? Comment SPEED and I will send it over.
